item.tib: lta sgom nyams kyi myos pa'i thol glu rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor dgyes pa'i mchod dbyangs
item.coloph: ces lta sgom nyams kyis myos pa'i thol glu ces bya ba srid zhi'i mtha' spangs ba'i dbra ston bstan 'dzin dbang rgyal gyi ye shes sgyu ma'i sku mngon par mchog gzigs dbra sprul bskal (skal) bzang bstan 'dzin nyi ma'i dbang po dang / o rgyan saMngs rgyas gling pa'i lung gis bsngags pa'-i bya btang mchog spral nyi ma'i mtshan can dang / 'bum sprul yid bzhin legs grub gtsos dpon slob bcu gsum gyis tshogs kyi 'khor lo bskor nas bskul ba'i ngor/ shar rdza'i bya bral bkra shis rgyal mtshan 'jig med dbang po'i sdes gang dran glu ru blangs par dge'o//
